people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
translations.bsb: But Jesus spoke up at once: “Take courage! It is I. Do not be afraid.”
translations.kjv: But straightway Jesus spake unto them, saying, Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
